resources.string: "Profile history, notes, favorite, monitoring settings and list records for @%1$s will be deleted from this device. Nothing changes on Instagram."
"No app is available to open the Instagram link."
"This person’s lists are also monitored automatically. Manage list selection from the Automatic monitoring card on the home screen; this switch only controls profile checks."
"List automation requires a mobile connection. Connect the account from your computer; existing records are preserved."
"List automation enabled. Pages will be read in sequence when Android allows it; existing cooldowns are preserved."
"%1$s accounts seen · list end observed. Next scan target: after %2$s."
"%1$s pages received; the list is limited or coverage is unknown. Waiting for the next scan cycle."
"Tap a row to open the saved list. Refresh only updates the status on this device; it does not send an Instagram request."

"Profile notifications are also enabled for the people you select; your own profile is queued for a check about once an hour. Automatic rounds start at least 15 minutes apart. A list round alternates between followers and following for the same account: up to 6 pages, with at least 15 seconds between request starts. New requests may start during the first 90 seconds of a round; an active request has its own timeout. These are app limits, not a guarantee of Instagram quotas. Android may delay or stop the task.

Downloaded pages are saved; remaining pages continue in the next round. Once the list end is observed, a new scan is targeted for 24 hours later. The first error, limited or uncertain result stops the round. 429 and verification cooldowns are preserved. Automatic tasks pause if notifications are disabled. Profile and list rounds take turns when both are ready.

The first read is a baseline. Difference notifications require two reads that both reached the list end; lists may change during pagination or Instagram may omit results. Results therefore mean newly seen / missing from this read, not definitive proof of a follow or unfollow.

Records are encrypted on this device. Up to 21 targets and their previous/current reads share a 512 KiB list storage budget. If capacity is reached, previous records are preserved and automatic saving pauses. Clearing list records resets baselines. Stopping list automation does not disable separate profile notifications for people."
"Comparison requires two separate reads that reached the list end. No change was inferred from a first, partial or limited read."
"These are list differences between two reads. Instagram may omit results and lists can change during a scan. They do not prove a follow/unfollow or an exact event time."
"A difference was observed in a saved list."
"Previous and current list reads for all targets will be deleted. New scans become baselines; profile history, people and the connection are preserved. The current request cooldown is not reset."
"List records cleared. The next automatic read will create a baseline; the current cooldown is preserved."
"The check is due; no new successful read yet."
"Automatic profile checks are off. List automation is managed separately; use Refresh person to read manually."
"Notification permission or the channel is off; automatic checks are also paused. Allow notifications in system settings."
"Instagram cooldown: no earlier than %1$s. A successful manual read after the cooldown re-enables automatic monitoring."
"The account needs reconnecting; automatic checks are paused."
"An account connection is being prepared; automatic checks are waiting."
"Automatic checks are paused. They resume after a permitted manual read succeeds."
"The device appears offline. Waiting for an internet connection."
"Waiting for the shared request cooldown. Other people and automatic own-account refreshes share this budget."

resources.string: "Eligible for a profile check; waiting for the shared queue and Android to run the task."

"This status updates when you open this screen or tap Update status; the button does not send an Instagram request. Intervals are targets: the queue, connectivity and Android battery management may cause delays. This is not instant monitoring."
"This field is not in the record yet. A baseline will be created if a future successful read includes it."
"Instagram returned null for this field; deletion was not assumed."
"This field could not be read in the expected format or within the storage budget. Counts are preserved."
"Photo changes are compared using the photo identity or default-photo status. A visible photo, if its URL is available, is shown separately from cache or the image server."
"No comparable photo identity in this response. A URL change alone does not produce a photo-change event."
"Instagram returned a different photo identity or default-photo status. This notification is not based on visual comparison; the same image may have been uploaded again."

"Previous observation: %1$s
New observation: %2$s

The change was observed between these reads. Its exact time is unknown."
"No comparable profile changes yet. The first known value is the baseline. Monitoring only covers retained successful observations."
"Monitors follower and following counts, username, biography if included in the response, and comparable photo information."
"No saved changes yet. They will appear here as new successful reads arrive."

"Shows the latest 20 saved observations. Count and profile differences are between known successful reads; they do not reveal an exact change time or who unfollowed. List activity is limited to existing page records for the most recently viewed profile. Opening the feed sends no new requests."
"Could not open list records. The feed only shows profile history."

"This screen shows pages downloaded to your device. The count is not the current Instagram profile total. Reaching the list end does not guarantee all accounts were received. Search only covers downloaded records; it sends no new requests. No automatic read starts when the wait ends."
"List end observed; completeness is not guaranteed."
"Instagram limited this list. Records are partial."
"Pagination did not advance. Records are preserved."
"On success, this direction’s record is replaced with a new first page. The other list is preserved."
"Only downloaded records are compared. Absence from a list does not prove someone does not follow back or has unfollowed."
"Could not open the saved connection or target. Go back and check your connection."
"You can try completing the connection once when you are ready."
"Could not verify the secure connection. Sign-in stopped."
"Sign-in is not complete. Finish the steps on Instagram’s screen."
